Description:
Failure of IT infrastructure and
external attacks to the IT envi-
ronment
Mitigating actions:
• Establishment of disaster recovery plans
(DRPs) and business continuity plans (BCPs); and
• Robust processes to safeguard against IT
infrastructure threats.

Description:
Inability to recover debts from our
customers in full
Mitigating actions:
• Periodic review of the credit policy and
strict enforcement of credit terms; and
• Continuous monitoring of debtor performance
and follow up.
• Loss allowance provision in line with IFRS 9

Risk:
Disruption in supply of
essential goods and
services
Description:
Possible disruption in the supply
of essential goods and services
Mitigating actions:
• Use of multiple vendors for essential supplies
of goods and services; and
• Rigorous vetting process for vendors.
